recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血液抹片中每個視野都有十多顆分葉與帶狀嗜中性球，白血球明顯增加且以成熟嗜中性球為主，未見母細胞，符合嗜中性球增多（neutrophilia）。
features: Markedly increased leukocytes for a low-power field, composed predominantly of segmented and band neutrophils
Neutrophils with mature clumped chromatin; several show pinkish-purple cytoplasmic granules, but toxic granulation and Dohle bodies are not well resolved at this power
No blasts or immature myeloid precursors identified in this field
Red cells with scattered echinocytes/crenated forms, likely drying artifact
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low magnification shows a marked increase in white blood cells, composed predominantly of mature segmented neutrophils and band forms. No blasts, promyelocytes or myelocytes are identified in this field, and basophilia is not evident. Toxic granulation and Dohle bodies, if present, require higher magnification for assessment. Red cells show scattered crenated forms, likely artifactual. Findings are consistent with neutrophilia, most often reactive (infection, inflammation, corticosteroids); correlation with the absolute count and clinical history is recommended.

ddx.vs: CML shows a left-shifted spectrum with a myelocyte bulge, basophilia and eosinophilia, rather than a predominantly mature neutrophil population.
CNL shows sustained mature neutrophilia (often without toxic changes) with CSF3R mutation, and requires exclusion of reactive causes.
Leukemoid reactions show more pronounced left shift with toxic granulation and Dohle bodies and a high LAP score, reflecting an extreme reactive response.
Leukoerythroblastosis shows immature myeloid cells together with nucleated red cells and teardrop cells, which are absent here.
